newsitem.title: USA: KCBT wheat closes lower as CBOT soybeans falter.
newsitem.headline: KCBT wheat closes lower as CBOT soybeans falter.

text.p: KCBT hard red winter wheat futures closed lower on a collapse in CBOT soybean futures, traders said.
"We broke late, led by beans," a trader said.
Signs the U.S. may be importing soybeans from Brazil led to the fall in CBOT soybean futures.

Wheat held strong much of the session on talk Egypt was seeking 500,000 tonnes of wheat and on a strong rally in CBOT wheat futures, traders said. But the Chicago wheat market also fell in late dealings as broad-based selling ensued, triggered by the sharp break in soybeans.
KCBT hard red winter wheat futures closed unchanged to 1-3/4 cents per bushel lower, with March unchanged at $4.39 a bushel and May down 1-3/4 cent at $4.10-1/2.
